more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.overview: Sodium ethyl para-hydroxybenzoate is the sodium salt of ethylparaben, a paraben-family preservative supplied as a hygroscopic powder. Its preservative role is to limit spoilage caused by microorganisms and extend the storage life of the food. The specified material is supplied as white powder or crystalline material.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4; non-heat–treated meat products; table-top sweeteners in liquid form.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
